name: leximate
description: Chrome/Edge MV3 vocabulary notebook with a bundled offline dictionary: select a word, keep it and its sentence, locally.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-dict.ts && node scripts/build-inflections.ts && wxt build
scripts.zip: node scripts/build-dict.ts && node scripts/build-inflections.ts && wxt zip
scripts.dict: node scripts/build-phonetics.ts && node scripts/build-dict.ts && node scripts/build-inflections.ts
scripts.dict:check: node scripts/build-phonetics.ts --check && node scripts/build-dict.ts --check && node scripts/build-inflections.ts --check
scripts.verify: node scripts/build-phonetics.ts --check && node scripts/build-dict.ts --check && node scripts/build-inflections.ts --check && node scripts/check-content-boundary.ts
